name: @app/aether-canvas-native
description: Aether 2.0 canvas package for React Native. Mirrors @app/aether-canvas (web R3F) for native R3F (via expo-three + @react-three/fiber/native) on surfaces with depth, and pure-Skia for the flat surfaces. Phase 4 native foundation, AE515. All pure math is re-exported from @app/aether-canvas-shared so the math is identical across web + native.
